plugins.name: ci-kit
plugins.description: Gates off the MacBook: ci-gate on the Bash PATH, a SessionStart note in repos that use ci-kit, and the adopt skill that sets a repo up

plugins.name: devcloud
plugins.description: The secrets guard: stored values, credential files and token-shaped strings become handles in what the model reads and the transcript keeps, restored to their bytes on write. And the host image and boot program that make any Linux userland work like your Mac. And the devenv skill, which writes a repository's devenv/ (its setup, services and checks) from its CI, manifests and README

plugins.name: to-human
plugins.description: The report view under the to-human output style: messages fold to their <message> spans, the working record (tool calls, agent and other sessions' messages) behind [ working record ] buttons; each message the model sends raises a notification (`$.ui.notify`)

plugins.name: sminos
plugins.description: The orchestration interface: the machine side of the MAWS desk, and how sessions and humans reach each other. The sminos CLI (the project log, messages between sessions, spawned seats, the daemon and its uplink to the desk hub), the bridge that makes a session watchable and steerable from outside it, the async AskUserQuestion, and the hooks that record what a session sent its human
